paper_sections.title: Neural correlates of craving and resisting craving for tobacco in nicotine dependent smokers.

description.value: The study investigated the brain regions associated with cue-elicited craving and actively resisting the urge to smoke in treatment-seeking nicotine-dependent smokers, including the effects of different resistance strategies.

design.value: Thirty-two treatment-seeking, nicotine-dependent smokers viewed blocks of smoking-related and neutral images alternating with rest during fMRI. They completed two back-to-back presentations, first with instructions to allow themselves to crave and second with instructions to resist the urge to smoke. The study used a block design and analyzed smoking-related cues versus neutral cues at individual and group levels.

name.value: healthy right-handed, treatment-seeking adult nicotine-dependent smokers

description.value: Thirty-two healthy right-handed, treatment-seeking adult nicotine-dependent smokers who smoked at least 10 cigarettes per day were recruited.

clinical_characteristics.value: Participants smoked, on average, 17.7 cigarettes per day (SD=6.9). FTND scores averaged 5.6 (SD=1.9). Random exhaled CO levels were 15.3 ppm (SD=6.1) at screening and 20.7 ppm (SD=12.2) two hours abstinent at scanning.

medication_status.value: Participants were excluded for current use of nicotine replacement therapy, bupropion, or varenicline; medications that could affect brain function were also exclusionary. Participants were instructed not to smoke for 2 hours prior to the visit.

task_description.value: Participants viewed standardized pictures of people smoking or engaged in neutral activities, as well as smoking-related and matched neutral objects, in a 12-minute sequence consisting of eight 90-second epochs. Each epoch contained a 24-second smoking-related image block, a 24-second neutral image block, and a 24-second rest block, with craving self-ratings after each block. The sequence was presented twice back to back, once under permissive craving instructions and once under resistance instructions.

instructions.value: Participants were instructed to “allow yourself to crave when you see the smoking related pictures,” followed by a second presentation with instructions to “resist the urge to smoke when you see the smoking pictures by any means you find helpful.”

stimuli.value: Standardized pictures of people smoking or engaged in neutral activities, matched in frequency and gender; smoking-related objects such as cigarette packages and ashtrays matched with neutral objects such as pencils and dishes; participants briefly handled and smelled a preferred brand cigarette before stimulus presentation.

task_performance_measures.value: Self-rating of craving on a scale of 0-10 after each block

instrument.value: 3.0 T Siemens Trio scanner (Siemens AG, Erlangen, Germany)

description.value: Functional scanning used a standard multislice single-shot gradient echo EPI sequence with 36 ascending transverse slices and approximate AC-PC alignment. Participants underwent two back-to-back fMRI stimulus presentations.

structured_details.value: {"matrix": "64×64", "slice_count": 36, "slice_orientation": "ascending transverse", "alignment": "approximate AC-PC", "sequence": "standard multislice single-shot gradient echo EPI"}

description.value: FSL pre-statistics processing included removal of non-brain tissue, motion correction, spatial smoothing, grand-mean intensity normalization, and highpass temporal filtering.

software.value: Motion Correction FMRIB Linear Image Registration Tool (MCFLIRT)

steps.value: Removal of non-brain with Brain Extraction Tool (BET)
Motion correction with Motion Correction FMRIB Linear Image Registration Tool (MCFLIRT)
Spatial smoothing with a Gaussian kernel of FWHM 8 mm
Grand-mean intensity normalization of the entire 4D dataset by a single multiplicative factor
Highpass temporal filtering using Gaussian-weighted least-squares straight line fitting with sigma=50.0s

model_type.value: time-series statistical analysis using a general linear model

model_settings.value: The first-level analysis used three primary variables: smoking-related cue crave condition, smoking-related cue resist condition, and neutral condition. Signal during self-rating craving measures was excluded. Contrasts were smoking-related cues minus neutral cues, neutral cues minus smoking-related cues, smoking-related Crave minus smoking-related Resist, and smoking-related Resist minus smoking-related Crave. Voxels were thresholded at Z>2.3 with final cluster thresholding at p=.05.
The second-level analysis compared across conditions within subjects using the same contrasts and statistical threshold as the first-level analysis.

estimator.value: FMRIB’s Local Analysis of Mixed Effects (FLAME 1) to estimate inter-session random-effects variance

software.value: FEAT FMRIB’s Local Analysis of Mixed Effects (FLAME 1)

model_settings.value: The third-level analysis analyzed across groups, described as resist versus crave, using the same contrasts and statistical threshold as the first-level analysis.

estimator.value: FMRIB’s Local Analysis of Mixed Effects (FLAME 1) to estimate inter-subject random-effects variance

software.value: FEAT FMRIB’s Local Analysis of Mixed Effects (FLAME 1)

model_settings.value: A less stringent analysis used fixed effects, forcing the random-effects variance to zero in FLAME, with a cluster threshold of p=.05.

estimator.value: fixed effects with the random-effects variance forced to zero

model_settings.value: For the distraction strategy, analysis used FLAME1+2 with clusters thresholded at p=.05. The comparison of distraction and contemplation of adverse effects used a less rigorous fixed effects analysis with clusters thresholded at p=.05.

interpretations.value: Exposure to visual smoking-related cues during permissive craving compared to neutral cues activated the left ACC, medial PFC, bilateral OFC, left middle cingulate gyrus, bilateral PCC, and bilateral precuneus.

footer.value: All analyses completed using cluster thresholding (z>2.3 and corrected cluster threshold of p=.05) at individual and group levels unless otherwise specified. Voxels is the number of activated voxel within each cluster. Z max is the local maximum z value. MNI (x, y, z) are the MNI coordinates for the local maximum. Anatomy is the MRIcron Anatomical Automatic Labeling (AAL) for local maximum (or closet label to maximum).
